purpose: Explicit table/writer classification. Generated title SQL has bounded J1c-1b integration; every other site remains uncovered. Source change detection is not runtime fencing.

limits.scanner: Unquoted forward CREATE/ALTER reference dependencies plus AST SQL execute/executemany/fetch/fetchrow/fetchval, filesystem and store/publication candidates; no runtime imports. Unsupported CREATE/REFERENCES grammar fails.
limits.ownership: Every FK parent retained, including added ALTER references and cycles. These are conservative historical dependency paths, not policy ownership. Account-control account_id and other non-FK ownership still require source-backed semantics.
limits.dynamic_sql: Unresolved/augmented/mixed-binding SQL arguments and interpolated strings are deferred candidates. Named-literal fingerprints include all resolved values; repeated identical calls have distinct occurrence identities.
limits.indirect_effects: No universal call-graph, receiver, trigger, SQL-function, SQL-data or provider-network-effect proof. Custom wrappers/aliases, nonliteral open modes via wrappers and effects outside listed roots/patterns need manual review; AST absence proves nothing.
limits.status: Only the explicit generated-title SQL site records integration, with a real PostgreSQL contract suite. All other entries remain uncovered. False positives remain conservative deferred candidates. Classifications authorize no bypass, marker or readiness.
